items.title: Delhi SEM court orders release of CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from judicial custody
items.summary: A Special Executive Magistrate court in Delhi on Wednesday evening ordered the release of CJP co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from judicial custody, ending the 7-day detention that began Oct 14 after they unfurled the Tricolour at Jantar Mantar in alleged breach of their peace bonds. The order came at the 2 PM IST surety-reconsideration hearing, where Delhi Police had sought three more days of custody; the magistrate declined the extension. Earlier in the day the duo withdrew their Delhi High Court plea challenging the custody after Justice Subramonium Prasad steered them toward the alternative remedy (HC left all contentions open). CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke reacted online with an emotional 'Chak De! India'-clip tribute reel reposting LiveLaw's breaking graphic; commenters framed the Vijayadashami-day release as a symbolic victory of truth.
